answer: Every new agent locks a refundable bond of 275 POA for 90 days, so one extra fake identity costs 275 POA and three months of frozen funds; a farm cannot share one bond across a thousand accounts. The bond is stamped in a public ledger like a timber log, so no agent can hide a second identity behind it. It sits in its own island escrow, an account no other identity can touch. Auditors picked at random check the work; cheaters lose the whole bond and their place on the lowest terrace of trust.
